alerts: Extreme Heat Warning until 7:00 p.m. Monday
weather.blurb: An Extreme Heat Warning is on. Early errands, lots of water, check on the neighbors.

air.blurb: Fine for most of us. If your lungs are touchy, take it a little easy.

lake.blurb: The lake is close to full — good for boats and for the summer water supply. Down a touch from last week.

pollen.blurb: A little grasses and ragweed around — most noses won't notice.

grid.blurb: A busy grid this afternoon, but ERCOT expects enough to go around.

sun.blurb: The sun is up for 13 hours and 2 minutes today, and down by 8:04 p.m.
